name: The Companies API
description: Company enrichment and search by domain, name, or attributes.

methods.label: Enrich Company by Domain
methods.description: Enrich a company from its domain (e.g. 'stripe.com'). Returns ~80 nested datapoints: about.name, about.industry, about.totalEmployees, domain.domain, locations.headquarters, socials, technologies.active, finances.revenue, descriptions.primary, assets.logoSquare, etc. 1 credit.

simplified.description: Return a smaller payload (free, no extra credits)

methods.label: Find Company by Name
methods.description: Look up a company by its name (e.g. 'Stripe'). Returns matching company object(s) — names aren't unique so multiple may return.

exactMatch.description: Require an exact name match (default true)

countries.description: Comma-separated country codes to filter, e.g. 'us,gb'

methods.label: Enrich Company by Social URL
methods.description: Enrich a company from one of its social network profile URLs. Pass whichever you have (linkedin is most useful for GTM). Returns the full company object. 1 credit.

methods.label: Get Company Email Patterns
methods.description: Get the email-format patterns a company uses (e.g. {first}.{last}@domain.com) with usage percentages. Returns the pattern, not specific people's emails. 1 credit.
